prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path decision helper, restore assurance), single-click and card carousel layouts, hotkey shortcut copy, and interactive waiting status updates consistently yield significant wins.
Harmful changes: Complex flow overhauls (docking setup, placement readiness check), intrusive split view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens lead to performance drops or early test terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, incentive badges, and background completion notifications repeatedly show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large positive predictions (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative results.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially hotkey shortcut copy, account identity/security hints, and interactive waiting status updates—frequently exceed low or negative initial predictions.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint: Display a prominent hint explaining that signing in automatically links and restores previously created pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets disappearing or resetting after sign-in.)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Awakening Trait Status Updates: Show step-by-step pet assembly stage indicators on the waiting screen while background generation finishes. (why: Home waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) causing users to lose track of progress.)
2: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Summon Copy Update: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to summon, locate, and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: Users wrote in asking how to reveal pets that failed to show up on the screen or how to control them.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Clarity Guidance Hint: Add explicit lighting and subject framing advice to the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Reassurance Headline: Update the adoption certificate headline to clarify that pet names and attributes can be modified anytime post-onboarding. (why: Adoption median duration is 89s with a 66.7% completion rate, indicating hesitation over final choices.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Audio Alert Cue: Enable optional desktop ready notification and chime on completion during pet waiting time. (why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to tab away before pet generation finishes.)

scores.note: Top support issue; restore assurance hints are proven high-confidence wins.
High home wait duration; interactive waiting status updates consistently yield strong wins.
Desktop summon copy/hotkey hints show solid positive lift and are cheap to implement.
Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck; photo lighting hints are explicit historical winners.
Targeting the 66.7% adoption bottleneck with reassurance copy, though adoption copy overall has mixed historical results.
Background completion notifications historically show no clear effect.
